lesson_title: The Counter on the Fridge Door
hook_text: This shop knows the moment stock goes missing. Yours could too.
clip_script: Think of a cooldrink fridge with a counter on the door — every bottle in, counted; every bottle out, counted. That is the perpetual inventory system. Every time he sells a backpack, TWO things get written at the till. The customer pays R450 — that is the sale. And the backpack that walked out had cost him R270 — so R270 leaves the stock counter as cost of sales, at the same moment. In December the counter says stock costing R52 000 should be there; his count finds R50 200. That R1 800 gap has a name and demands an answer.
visual_style: A fridge door with a glowing digital counter ticking up and down; a till splitting each sale into two flying numbers; a dramatic gap appearing at stocktake.
pacing: Rhythmic counting beats, double-entry split in slow motion, sharp sting on the missing R1 800.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master the system your whole year runs on.
